title: Section-normalized ordinary strict quotient presentation
statement: Let T be a small site, A a commutative ring and I an ideal. The constant and quotient ring sheaves on the vertical sequence site are the sequence rings of the constant A diagram and (A/I^(n+1)) [lem-pur-system-ringed-sequence-site]. A strict quotient diagonal presentation consists of their actual quotient ring map, the section-normalized equivalence between constant-ring sequence modules and module towers, the exact constant diagonal, scalar insertion x ↦ 1 tensor x, and the pure-tensor-normalized comparison with the quotient-reduction tower [def-pur-strict-quotient-completion-data]. Its derived restriction, diagonal, reduction and representative comparison use the standard derived categories and existing universal scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. The derived restriction and reduction are stored as model fields with defining equalities to the original composite functors; these redundant fields add no comparison hypothesis, since the composites themselves fill them with reflexive equations.
